warnings: Radius is derived from stitch count and gauge, treating each round as a perfect circle; it is not a measurement of a physical object.
Row height is one round gauge unit, scaled per round by the dominant stitch family's height relative to the family the gauge was measured in; it does not otherwise vary across crown, body, and brim.
The crown is modelled as a hemispherical cap for visual continuity, not derived from the increase schedule's actual curvature.
Yarn diameter is a visual default (half a stitch width) unless overridden; it is not a measured yarn property.
